title: That Blavatsky woman started it. She was a nice old bag of tricks.
html_source: Madame Blavatsky, first name Helena, was a well-known Russian occultist who lived in the 19th century.

anchor.text: That Blavatsky woman started it. She was a nice old bag of tricks.
anchor.prefix: — Professor Magennis was speaking to me about you, J. J. O'Molloy said to Stephen. What do you think really of that hermetic crowd, the opal hush poets: A. E. the mastermystic?
